crossRefs.note: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
You will save the afflicted people, But your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man…
He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.
Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;
I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul!…
Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish…
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…

parallels.note: You will save the afflicted people, But your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

translations.web: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
translations.bsb: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
translations.kjv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
translations.asv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes thou wilt bring down.
